paragraphs: MatX is a full-featured React Material UI Admin Dashboard template. MatX is built with React, Redux & Material UI We implemented all the features you might need to start a new Web application. The free version includes all Material UI components, Form elements, and validation, JWT authentication, Sign in, sign up pages, Vertical navigation, Lazy loading, Code splitting.
